name: Innocent Family
source:
What is the definition of a family? Blood bonds? Mamoru has fun with his mother-in-law and sister-in-law every day. It's not a usual family, but he swore to protect and love the people who are important to him. There are also girls outside his house, so his life can get a bit noisy, but he can handle it, no worries.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/02/vn-of-month-march-2001.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
家庭的定义是什么？血缘关系？Mamoru每天都和婆婆、嫂子一起开心地度过。这不是一个普通的家庭，但他发誓要保护和爱对他来说重要的人。他家外面也有女孩，所以他的生活可能会有点吵，但他可以应付，不用担心。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/02/vn-of-month-march-2001.html]vndbreview[/url]]
